#Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
MiniDot1 <- read_csv(here("Data/Tank_Data/HOBOSensors/646496_MiniDot_Tank24.csv"))
MiniDot2 <- read_csv(here("Data/Tank_Data/HOBOSensors/735729_MiniDot_Sump5.csv"))
DO1 <- read_csv(here("Data/Tank_Data/HOBOSensors/22482990_DO_CTD_SUMP5.csv"))
DO2 <- read_csv(here("Data/Tank_Data/HOBOSensors/22482991_DO_CTD_Tank24.csv"))
pH1 <- read_csv(here("Data/Tank_Data/HOBOSensors/22491060_pH_SUMP5.csv"))
pH2 <- read_csv(here("Data/Tank_Data/HOBOSensors/22491061_pH_Tank24.csv"))
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

mutate(Date = lubridate::ymd(Date)) %\>% filter(between(Date, ymd("2025-08-01"), ymd("2025-08-15"))) %\>%

```{r}
MiniDotData <- full_join(MiniDot1, MiniDot2)
DoCTDData <- full_join(DO2, DO1)

DoData <- full_join(MiniDotData, DoCTDData, by = c("Instrument","Tank", "DateTime", "DO", "Temperature")) 
  
DoDataFilter <- DoData %>% mutate(DateTime = lubridate::mdy_hm(DateTime)) %>%
  filter(between(DateTime,mdy_hm("03-17-2026 16:00"), mdy_hm("03-19_26 09:30")))


pHData <- rbind(pH1, pH2) 
phDataFilter <- pHData %>% mutate(DateTime = lubridate::mdy_hm(DateTime)) %>%
  filter(between(DateTime,mdy_hm("03-17-2026 16:00"), mdy_hm("03-19_26 09:30")))



```

```{r}
OrionData <- data.frame(DateTime = c(mdy_hm("03-18-2026 12:43","03-18-2026 20:29" , "03-18-2026 12:52","03-18-2026 20:39" )), 
              DO =c(8.16, 6.57, 6.64, 6.4), 
              Tank = c("Tank24", "Tank24", "Sump5", "Sump5")
                        )

pHOrionData <- data.frame(DateTime = c(mdy_hm("03-18-2026 12:43","03-18-2026 20:29" , "03-18-2026 12:52","03-18-2026 20:39" )), 
                          pH = c(8.16, 8.09, 8.11, 8.07), 
                          Millivolts = c(-66.6, -61.9, -62.9, -60.6), 
                          Tank = c("Tank24", "Tank24", "Sump5", "Sump5"))
```

```{r}
p1<- ggplot(DoDataFilter, aes(DateTime, DO, group_by = "Instrument", color = Instrument)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~Tank) 
   # annotate( "point",
   #         x = mdy_hm("03-18-2026 12:43"), 
   #         y = 7.01, 
   #         size =8,
   #         color = "blue") +
   # annotate( "point",
   #         x = mdy_hm("03-18-2026 20:29"), 
   #         y = 6.57, 
   #         size =8,
   #         color = "blue")
  
DOPlot <- p1 +
  geom_point(data =OrionData, color = "blue", size =7)

ggsave(here("Output","DOPlot.png"), 
            width =9, height =6)
```

```{r}
 p2 <- ggplot(phDataFilter, aes(DateTime, pH, group_by = "Instrument", color = Instrument)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~Tank) 
 
 pHPlot <- p2 +  
  geom_point(data =pHOrionData, color = "blue", size =2)
 
 ggsave(here("Output","pHPlot.png"), 
            width =9, height =6)
```

```{r}
 p3 <- ggplot(phDataFilter, aes(DateTime, Millivolts, group_by = "Instrument", color = Instrument)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~Tank) 
   
    MillivoltPlot <- p3 + geom_point(data =pHOrionData, color = "blue", size =2)
    
    ggsave(here("Output","MillivoltPlot.png"), 
            width =9, height =6)
    
    

```
